# AI Website Growth Audit

> Free AI-powered website audit for small businesses, covering SEO, performance, accessibility, trust, mobile, conversion and local SEO — with clear, prioritised recommendations and growth opportunities. Built and operated by Dean Da Dev.

The tool automatically detects whether a submitted URL is a marketing website or a web app (SaaS product, login-gated tool, PWA) and scores it accordingly — website-only checks (e.g. local SEO, Google Business Profile signals) are skipped for apps so they aren't penalised for not having them. Audits run for free on the free plan; the Pro plan (see /pricing) adds more monitored sites, daily automated scans, competitor tracking and instant downtime/content-change alerts via push notification.
